_comment: Model knowledge-cutoff registry. A backtest window must start AFTER the selected model's cutoff or its decisions may be contaminated by memorized future outcomes. Fill in exact dates and set verified=true once confirmed from the provider's docs. Unknown/unverified models are treated conservatively by the gate (status 'unknown' -> not certifiable as clean). Dates are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' (the last date the model could know about).
